name: Obsidian Veil
slogan: We see what you will become.
motto: Flesh is temporary. Obsidian is eternal.
description: The premier megacorp for human (re)design. Where others sell cyberware, Obsidian Veil sells evolution. They don’t augment your body — they rewrite what it means to be human. Sleek, elegant, and terrifyingly precise.

achievements.title: Obsidian Conversion
achievements.description: First successful full-body Obsidian Conversion (subject reported 'feeling like liquid night').

achievements.title: Veil Lattice Launch
achievements.description: Launched the Veil Lattice — programmable nanomachines that rewrite DNA in real time.

achievements.title: Project Eternity
achievements.description: First documented client reached biological age 147 while appearing 29.

achievements.title: Chromedream Line
achievements.description: Released the Chromedream Line — luxury augmentations that make you look like a living anime character.

achievements.title: Biotech Integration
achievements.description: Acquired three rival biotech firms and immediately 'integrated' their research teams.

divisions.name: Obsidian Aesthetics
divisions.tagline: Beauty is obsolete. Elegance is eternal.

divisions.name: Shadowform Security
divisions.tagline: You won’t see us coming. You’ll become us.

divisions.name: Ascension Clinics
divisions.tagline: First visit is free. Second is mandatory.

dossier.psychProfile: Hypnotically elegant and fundamentally post-human. Seraphine has replaced nearly 90% of her biological matter. She views baseline humanity as 'charming artifacts'. Deep, unresolved sibling rivalry with Elias Voss (TheEye).
dossier.attackVectors: Vulnerable to philosophical challenges regarding the 'soul' of post-humanity. Responds to rare, pre-collapse genetic sequences. Can be manipulated by playing on her competitive streak with her brother.
leakedMemos: Seraphine to Ascension Team: 'The goal is not to improve the human; it is to replace the concept of humanity entirely.'
Confidential: 'Subject 47 reported seeing 'obsidian light' during the Lattice rewrite. Increase dosage.'

rivalShade.intel: My brother's 'Predictive Mesh' has a blind spot in localized nanotech swarms. He can't see what he can't index. I am that blind spot.

quickhackVault.name: Ascension Override
quickhackVault.description: Temporarily rewrites enemy combat subroutines to identify you as 'Admin'. Turn enemies into allies. Flavor: 'Become the upgrade.'

blackmail: Evidence of 'Project Eternity' subjects being kept in a state of digital limbo against their will.
Logs showing Seraphine's secret attempts to hack into Panopticon's 'God Mode' protocol.
dossier.executiveBackdoor: Password: VeilHasNoFlesh42069. Special effect: Grants 'Obsidian Ghost' status for 1 hour.
